column1: # model_file: libs.tech/ngspice/sm141064.ngspice (+ sm141064_mim.ngspice via mimcap_* sections)
# kd_near: charge-pump gain at the lock point
# ratio:   kd_near / kd_wide -- 1.0 is perfectly linear through zero
#          zone drives it toward 0.  Acceptance: > 0.5 at every corner.
# wmin_zero: smaller of the two UP/DN pulse widths at dphi=0 (s) = PFD reset delay
# q_zero:  net charge per reference cycle at dphi=0 (C) -- the residual
#          up/down asymmetry the loop must null out
# t_offset: static phase offset that nulls it
